description: This file contains implementation of a fake proof source handle used for testing in the QUIC protocol, including classes and methods for certificate selection and signature computation, with support for synchronous and asynchronous actions.

classes.name: ComputeSignatureResult
classes.description: Struct to hold the result of a signature computation, including success status, signature string, and additional details.

classes.name: ResultSavingSignatureCallback
classes.description: Callback class that saves the signature result into a provided optional result object.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle
classes.description: A mock implementation of a proof source handle used for testing, supporting certificate selection and signature computation with various action modes.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::SelectCertOperation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous or synchronous certificate selection operation.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::ComputeSignatureOperation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous or synchronous signature computation operation.

methods.name: ComputeSignatureNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate signature computation using the delegate ProofSource.
